title: A Choir for the Crown
author: Sebastian Galloway
blurb: Bram Winterbourne, the youngest member of a dying guild, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
